labels.decoded: read at the stated offset, with the oracle named
labels.UNKNOWN: no header/decoder pins it; the blocker is named

atoms.rule: a hkpConstraintAtom starts with a 16-bit type code; the code at each listed offset is identical in every object of the class across the fleet, while the payload after it varies per car
atoms.extent_rule: extent = next atom start - this atom start (the last atom runs to the object extent)
atoms.names: UNKNOWN: the Havok 2014.1 atom-type enum is not in this project; types are reported by their decoded numeric code

transforms.layout: 3 rows of 4 floats at +0/+0x10/+0x20, translation at +0x30 (64 B per frame)

first_pass.note: counts re-derived from PHYSICS_ROLES2.json's own angle_like_tail offsets and the donor's decoded frame translations (+0x60, +0xA0)

unknowns: the atom type names (limits / motor / ball-socket / friction): the 2014.1 hkpConstraintAtom enum is not in this project, so only the numeric code is decoded
which ragdoll axis each of the three limit atoms is (cone / plane / twist): the three atoms carry the same shape (min, max, 0.8) and nothing in the bytes orders them
the non-limit atoms' fields: their bytes are constant per class but no oracle pins a name
for hinges the joint's free axis is not named by these bytes; only that the class has one angular limit pair
